access: A Databricks workspace with a development pipeline or target where the agent may run validate and development updates

presentation.name: Design Databricks declarative pipelines: table types, expectations, CDC
presentation.summary: Designs Lakeflow pipelines (formerly DLT): a streaming table or materialized view per dataset, expectations, AUTO CDC and Auto Loader ingestion, without a full refresh losing history.
benefits: Picks a streaming table or a materialized view by whether old rows must change when their inputs change
Chooses warn, drop or fail for each expectation by what a bad record costs, and keeps failing records when someone needs to see them
Builds SCD Type 1 or 2 with AUTO CDC, with ordering, deletes and tracked columns set deliberately
Sets Auto Loader types and schema evolution so new or malformed columns are not dropped silently
Protects streaming tables whose source cannot be replayed from a full refresh
